# Confirms the shared engine imports and reports which optional
# packages are active. Handy first stop when a render misbehaves.
import _common as C

print(f"Optional packages")
print(f"  xgboost     : {'installed' if C.HAS_XGBOOST else 'absent (using scikit-learn)'}")
print(f"  folium      : {'installed' if C.HAS_FOLIUM else 'absent (using matplotlib)'}")
print(f"  matplotlib  : {'installed' if C.HAS_MATPLOTLIB else 'absent'}")
print(f"\nAll data is generated in-process. No files or network required.")
